title: Soul Feast #74: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – The Angel
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

In this transformative Soul Feast, Gary Zukav reveals his first encounters with non-physical teachers – beings that once seemed impossible to his five-sensory mind but became essential guides on his spiritual journey. From a jet-lagged evening in Stockholm where he met Ambrose – a presence that knew impossible details about Gary’s time in the desert – to his profound relationship with Genesis, Gary describes the opening of doorways into non-physical reality. These were not abstract concepts but intimate, life-altering moments that challenged the very foundation of how he understood reality, connection, and the Earth School.

The friction Gary carried during these years wasn’t just about sexuality; it was the heavy burden of addiction and the pursuit of external power through the objectification of others. Genesis, a non-physical teacher, did not permit Gary’s personality to hide behind its defenses. When Gary finally sat before this presence, the unspoken question in his heart was met with a direct hit of truth: the issue was not his sexuality, but his understanding of love and power. This was the pivotal moment where the personality’s desperate need for control met the Soul’s invitation to experience authentic connection.

The wisdom Gary received was a reframe for all of multisensory humanity: 

Communication with non-physical teachers is available to everyone, and within that relationship comes the ability to distinguish frightened parts of the personality from the loving parts of the personality.

By learning to recognize the frequency of Genesis’s guidance among the many voices in his mind, Gary discovered that Authentic Power is not found in the temporary relief of addiction, but in the Responsible Choice to choose love, no matter what fear demands.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (03:10) — From Radical to Normal: How the ideas in Gary’s first book about the new consciousness, once considered radical in 1989, are now the lived experience of four billion multisensory humans.
  • (05:00) — Meeting Ambrose: Gary’s first encounter with a non-physical teacher in Stockholm—how Ambrose knew about his dreams in the desert and ignited a small flame that Gary had to keep alive by making the Responsible Choice to speak with people.
  • (10:13) — Genesis and the Unspoken Question: The moment Genesis answered the question Gary didn’t have the courage to ask about his sexual addiction, redirecting him from the personality’s struggle to the nature of love and power.
  • (13:45) — Communication Is Established: How Genesis placed a thought in Gary’s mind, taught him to recognize that specific frequency of guidance, and established direct communication that has continued for 40 years.
  • (17:18) — The 1987 Shift: Genesis’s announcement of the Harmonic Convergence—a thousand-year-planned event intended to increase humanity’s openness to multisensory consciousness across three generations.
  • (19:20) — The Humanness of Ambrose: Why Gary describes Ambrose as the most warm, connected, and human presence he’s ever encountered—a very old and good friend in non-physical form.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of a moment when you received guidance that seemed to come from beyond your own thinking – a sudden knowing, a voice that spoke truth you couldn’t ignore, or wisdom that arrived precisely when you needed it most. Perhaps it happened in meditation, in nature, or in a quiet moment when your mind finally stopped its noise.

Pause and ask yourself: What if that guidance was real? What if you already have a non-physical teacher waiting to communicate with you, but the five-sensory consciousness you were taught keeps you from hearing? What if the issue you’re struggling with isn’t what you think it is – and a deeper question, one you haven’t yet had the courage to ask, is waiting to be answered? Gently invite yourself to consider: could you be ready to recognize that voice when it speaks?
